en: Introduction. The Komodo dragon is the largest lizard alive today. It is found in the wild only in Indonesia.

Where it lives. Komodo dragons live on a few islands in East Nusa Tenggara, including Komodo, Rinca and parts of Flores. Their homes are hot, dry grasslands and forests. Much of this area is protected as Komodo National Park.
Body. An adult can grow to about 3 metres long, which is longer than a family car is wide. It has a long, strong tail, sharp claws and tough, scaly skin.
Senses. A Komodo dragon flicks out its long, forked tongue to collect smells from the air. This helps it find food from far away.
Food. Komodo dragons are meat-eaters. They hunt animals such as deer and wild pigs, and they also eat animals that are already dead.

Young. A female lays her eggs in a hole in the ground. When the babies hatch, they are only about 40 centimetres long. Young dragons spend much of their time up in trees, where they are safer from adult dragons.
People and dragons. Visitors to the national park walk with trained rangers and keep a safe distance. Protecting the islands and the animals the dragons eat helps this rare lizard survive.
id: Pendahuluan. Komodo adalah kadal terbesar yang masih hidup saat ini. Di alam liar, komodo hanya ditemukan di Indonesia.

Habitat. Komodo hidup di beberapa pulau di Nusa Tenggara Timur, antara lain Pulau Komodo, Rinca, dan sebagian Flores. Tempat tinggalnya padang rumput dan hutan yang panas dan kering. Sebagian besar wilayah ini dilindungi sebagai Taman Nasional Komodo.
Tubuh. Komodo dewasa bisa tumbuh sampai sekitar 3 meter, lebih panjang daripada lebar sebuah mobil keluarga. Ekornya panjang dan kuat, cakarnya tajam, dan kulitnya keras bersisik.
Indra. Komodo menjulurkan lidahnya yang panjang dan bercabang untuk menangkap bau di udara. Ini membantunya menemukan makanan dari jauh.
Makanan. Komodo adalah pemakan daging. Mereka memburu hewan seperti rusa dan babi hutan, dan juga memakan bangkai hewan.

Anak komodo. Komodo betina bertelur di lubang di tanah. Saat menetas, panjang bayinya hanya sekitar 40 sentimeter. Komodo muda banyak menghabiskan waktu di atas pohon, tempat mereka lebih aman dari komodo dewasa.
Manusia dan komodo. Pengunjung taman nasional berjalan bersama jagawana terlatih dan menjaga jarak aman. Melindungi pulau-pulau dan hewan mangsa komodo membantu kadal langka ini bertahan hidup.

factChecks.claim: The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard.
Wild Komodo dragons live only on a few Indonesian islands including Komodo, Rinca and Flores, much of it in Komodo National Park.
Adults can reach about 3 metres in length.
Komodo dragons use their forked tongues to sense smells.
They eat deer, pigs and carrion.
Hatchlings are roughly 40 cm long and young dragons often live in trees.
Visitors to Komodo National Park walk with rangers.
